Lamborghini Gallardo + Interior + Cycles
Original model: Neubi / Neubi3D
Source: https://blendswap.com/blend/8686
Original permalink: http://www.blendswap.com/blends/view/67469

The license included with the downloaded ZIP is Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 (CC BY-SA 3.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
The archived source-license.html also marks the model as Fan Art and states
that commercial use is not allowed. That notice is retained for the spatial study and the main racing game.
See source-readme.txt for the original author and vehicle-design notices.

Modified GLB: original cockpit for Dream Garage, used in the spatial study
and the main Tavaculo city race (2026-10-22). The handling comparison
prototype reuses this same converted model and notices.
Changes: selected original interior/body meshes; one common uniform scale
and axis transform; neutral materials instead of original textures; reduced
high-density small controls and seat-base meshes; no exterior wheels/engine.
The derivative model is distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0 with the original
noncommercial Fan Art notice retained. No endorsement is claimed.
The measured 4.30 m body-length convention and driver eye anchor are study
settings, not a claim of surveyed real-car or original-model accuracy.
Original part shapes, sizes and positions remain linked by one common scale.

Main-game integration reuses the same converted GLB without resizing source
parts or changing their mesh data. The source steering wheel rotates around
its mapped original axis; the column cover and stalks remain fixed. Separate
live mirror and speed/gear display geometry is added by the game. Driver-eye
position and the camera follow the car body, with a small steering-linked
look direction. These additions do not replace the original source notices.

This asset notice applies to the model, not to all code in the game repository.
